༄༅/ /'chi med tshe'i skor gyi dbang gnad zab tshe'i dbang bskur gyi las byang dbang dang

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'chi med tshe'i skor gyi dbang gnad zab tshe'i dbang bskur gyi las byang dbang dang

bcas pa bzhugs so// gu ru tshe dpag med la na mo// 'chi med tshe'i phyi dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ tshe gtor/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril/ mda' dar sogs 'du byas la/ hrīḥ sku gsum bla ma tshe dpag med// bdag cag 'gro rnams skyabs su mchi// 'gro kun 'chi med thob bya'i slad// bdag gis lam 'dir 'bad par bya| |zhes gsum/ bgegs la gtor ma byin brlabs shing bsngos la/ hrīḥ 'chi med bsgrub la bar gcod pa'i// dam sri log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs// gtor ma 'di khyer gzhan du dengs// gal te mi 'gro nyams par bgyi// bdag nyid dbang chen khros pa'i rdzu// 'phrul gyi khro tshogs stong gsum khengs// bgegs kyi gshed ma 'jigs rngam tshul// rdo rje'i ra gur sra zhing brtan// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha badz+ra rak+ṣa kurban+tu// zhes bka' bsgo mtshams bcad/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes mchod gtor sogs byin brlabs/ bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag dang gtor ma stong 'byams 'od gsal ngang*// pad+ma zla nyi'i gdan la skad cig gis// rig 'dzin pad+ma dkar gsal mdangs dang ldan// rin chen rus pa'i rgyan can yid 'ong ba// mnyam bzhag phyag gis tshe bum 'od 'bar 'dzin// rdor skyil pang du lha lcam man+da ra// dmar gsal 'od 'bar bcu drug lon pa'i nyams// nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rab tu rgyas// rin chen rus rgyan yid 'ong pad skyil 'khril// phyag gnyis tshe bum 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// yab yum stong gsal bde ba'i nyams dang ldan// yab kyi spyi mgrin snying lte gsang gnas lngar// dkar dmar sngo ser ljang ba'i pad sdong brtsegs// bde chen 'khor lo sangs rgyas tshe dpag med// dkar po kun bzang dkar mo yum dang sbyor// longs spyod 'khor lo pad+ma tshe dpag med// dmar po gos dkar yum dang gnyis med 'khril// chos kyi 'khor lo rdo rje tshe dpag med// sngon po mā ma kī dang 'khyud sbyor tshul// sprul pa'i 'khor lo rat+na tshe dpag med// ser po sangs rgyas spyan dang dga' bar 'khril// bde skyong 'khor lo karma tshe dpag med// ljang gu sgrol ma yum dang mnyam por sbyor// yab rnams mnyam bzhag tshe bum rdor skyil pang*// yum rnams g.yas pas mda' dar rang mdog can/

/g.yon pa tshe bum pad skyil yab la 'khril// kun kyang longs sku'i cha lugs mtshan dper ldan// gnas lngar oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā rnams ni// dkar dmar sngo ser ljang las 'od 'phros pas// pad+ma 'od nas ye shes spyan drangs bstim// hrīḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas tshe dpag med// rigs lnga'i tshogs bcas gnas 'dir gshegs shing bzhugs// bdag cag gus pas 'dud cing phyag bgyi'o// oṃ badz+ra gu ru pañtsa ā yurde wa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ hrīḥ thugs rje pad 'byung tshe lha 'khor bcas la// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos mar me// dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga// sman raka gtor tshogs rgya mtsho mchod par 'bul// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā ru dhī ra ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi/ hrīḥ 'chi med dbang po grub mchog pad+ma 'byung*// yab yum gnas lngar rigs kyi tshe dpag med// yum bcas longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dpe rdzogs// ma bsgrib chu zla ji bzhin snang la bstod// ces bstod do// lha rnams gnas lnga'i sa bon las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur spros pas/ 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud tshe dpal 'byor ba kun bsdus nas| thim pas 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par bsam/ oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūṃ hūm̐/ bud+dha'i gnas su/ pad+ma/ badz+ra/ rat+na/ karma/ sbyar la bsnyen pa nus tshad 'bad de bya/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ gsum gyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod pas byin brlabs tshogs phud 'bul/ hrīḥ 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa ni// sna tshogs nam mkha'i khams bkang ba// 'chi med lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// dgyes zhing tshim par bzhes nas kyang*// thugs dam bskangs la bar chad sol// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra gu ru pañtsa ā yurde wa ga ṇa tsakra pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ

zhes 'bul/ longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus/ a kā ro lan gsum dang*/ hrīḥ tshogs kyi lhag ma'i pha 'bab bza' btung bcas// 'chi med bdag po'i bka' nyan 'khor tshogs la| |legs par 'bul gyis tshim shing rangs gyur nas// bdag gi tshe yi bar gcod zhi bar mdzod// uts+tshiṣ+ṭa sarba pa ti khā hi/ zhes phul/ slob dpon bdag 'jug blang*// slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod| |bgegs gtor byin la maṇ+ḍal 'bul// gsol gdab dris lan byin dbab cing*// dmigs pa dang bcas tshe 'gugs pa'i// bar rnams phyi dbang dkyus bzhin bya// dngos gzhi dbang bskur 'di lta ste/ */gtor ma gu ru yab yum gyi gnas lngar tshe dpag med rigs lnga yab yum rnams gsal ba'i bud+dha tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa nas bdud rtsi dkar po bab pas gu ru yab yum gyi sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams dang bum pa nas bdud rtsi dkar po bab/ slob ma gu ru yab yum gyi spyi bo'i bud+dha tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum par bab/ bum pa gang zhing lud pas slob ma'i spyi bo'i pad 'dab khengs/ de las kyang bdud rtsi bab pas mgo'i nang thams cad bdud rtsi dkar gsal bkrag mdangs ldan pas gang*/ gti mug gi nyes ltung sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa'i khams dang 'byung ba nam mkha'i khams nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ me long lta bu'i 'khor 'das yongs grol gyi rang byung bzhi'i dga' ba'i ye shes thob/ gu ru rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi rang bzhin mngon du byas par bsams la/ oṃ/ sku yi dbang mchog bud+dha tshe dpag med// sogs phyi dbang ltar spyi bor bskur/ de bzhin du/ gtor ma gu ru yab yum gyi gnas lngar tshe dpag med rigs lnga yab yum rnams gsal ba'i pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa nas bdud rtsi dmar gsal bab pas gu ru yab yum gyi sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams dang bum pa nas bdud rtsi dmar po bab/ slob ma gu ru yab yum gyi mgrin pa'i pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum par bab/

bum pa gang zhing lud pas slob ma'i mgrin pa'i pad 'dab khengs/ de las kyang bdud rtsi bab pas mgrin pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad bdud rtsi dmar gsal bkrag mdangs ldan pas gang*/ 'dod chags kyi nyes ltung sbyangs/ drod kyi khams dang 'byung ba me'i khams nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ so sor rtog bral lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i ye shes thob/ gu ru pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi rang bzhin mngon du byas par bsams la/ āḥ gsung gi dbang mchog pad+ma tshe dpag med| |sogs/ gtor ma gu ru yab yum gyi gnas lngar tshe dpag med rigs lnga yab yum rnams gsal ba'i rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa nas bdud rtsi sngon po bab pas gu ru yab yum gyi sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams dang bum pa nas bdud rtsi sngon po bab/ slob ma gu ru yab yum gyi snying ga'i rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum par bab/ bum pa gang zhing lud pas slob ma'i snying ga'i pad 'dab khengs/ de las kyang bdud rtsi bab pas lte ba yan snying ga phyin lag sor tshun bdud rtsi mthing gsal bkrag mdangs ldan pas gang*/ zhe sdang gi nyes ltung sbyangs/ khrag gi khams dang 'byung ba chu'i khams nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ chos dbyings dga' bral gyi ye shes thob/ gu ru rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi rang bzhin mngon du byas par bsams la/ hūm̐ */ thugs kyi dbang mchog rdo rje tshe dpag med// sogs/ gtor ma gu ru yab yum gyi gnas lngar tshe dpag med rigs lnga yab yum rnams gsal ba'i rat+na tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa nas bdud rtsi ser po bab pas gu ru yab yum gyi sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams dang bum pa nas bdud rtsi ser po bab/ slob ma gu ru yab yum gyi lte ba'i rat+na tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum par bab/ bum pa gang zhing lud pas slob ma'i lte ba'i pad 'dab khengs/ de las kyang bdud rtsi bab pas lte ba man spu mtshams yan bdud rtsi ser gsal bkrag mdangs ldan pas gang*/

nga rgyal dang ser sna'i nyes ltung sbyangs/ sha dang rus pa'i khams dang 'byung ba'i khams nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ mnyam pa nyid kyi mchog dga'i ye shes thob/ gu ru rat+na tshe dpag med kyi rang bzhin mngon du byas par bsams la/ trāṃ/ yon tan dbang mchog rat+na tshe dpag med// sogs/ gtor ma gu ru yab yum gyi gnas lngar tshe dpag med rigs lnga yab yum rnams gsal ba'i karma tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa nas bdud rtsi ljang gu bab pas gu ru yab yum gyi sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams dang bum pa nas bdud rtsi ljang gu bab| slob ma gu ru yab yum gyi gsang gnas karma tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum par bab/ bum pa gang zhing lud pas slob ma'i gsang gnas kyi pad 'dab khengs/ de las kyang bdud rtsi bab pas rkang sor nas long bu pus mo dpyi dang gsang gnas phyin bdud rtsi ljang gsal bkrag mdangs dang ldan pas gang*/ phrag dog gi nyes ltung sbyangs/ dbugs kyi khams dang 'byung ba rlung gi khams nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ bya ba grub pa'i bde stong gi dga' ba'i ye shes thob/ gu ru karma tshe dpag med kyi rang bzhin mngon du byas par bsams la/ āḥ phrin las dbang mchog karma tshe dpag med// sogs/ dkyus ltar bskur/ de rjes tshe ril dang tshe chang rigs lnga'i sngags bzla zhing sbyin/ ye dhar dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog gtor zhing brtan par byas/ tshe dbang tshar grangs gsog na kun gyi tha mar dang*/ de min rjes su/ gtor ma gu ru yab yum du gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i tshe lha rigs lnga las lha rang rang dang 'dra ba re re spros te/ slob ma'i gnas lnga'i lha rnams so sor thim pas/ slob ma'i gnas lnga'i tshe dpag med rnams 'od du zhu ba gnas rnams su thim ma thag /slob ma gu ru yab yum du gsal ba yang 'od zer du gyur te/ lnga ldan thig le chen po stong gsal ti la ka nyag gcig gi rang mdangs su mnyam par gyur pa la/ tshe mda' bsrung ba'i lha mo lngas 'khor lo/

pad+ma/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ rgya gram rnams dkar| dmar/ mthing*/ ser/ ljang ba'i phyag rgyas btab pas/ 'dus byas 'phral rkyen gyi 'tshe ba gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing gzhom zhig dang bral ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bltas la/ bh+rūṃ/ ye shes lha mo tshe mda' bsrung ba'i lha// sogs/ dkyus ltar gnas lngar gtug /dam tshig khas blang gtang rag dbul/ rjes ni/ bdag mdun lha la mchod bstod cing*/ chad mdo gtor ma sman raka bran/hrīḥ mā ra ti ka'i brag phug tu// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// lha lcam man+da ra ba yis// 'chi med rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i tshe// khas blangs dam bcas srung ma'i tshogs// 'dir spyon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// 'chi med bsgrub pa'i bar gcod sol// oṃ ā yuḥmaṇ+ḍal rak+ṣan+tu pū dza khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ tshogs gzhong sman 'bru dang gser skyems kyis bkang*/ brtan ma bskyang ba ni/ hrīḥ 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// bod yul skyong bar bka' bsgos pa'i// brtan ma chen mo bcu gnyis kyang*// ya ma skyong ma'i tshogs dang bcas// sman phran 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// 'dir byon bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes// rnal 'byor tshe yi bar chad srungs// bod khams chos bzhin skyong bar mdzod// shā sa na pa riwā ra pū dza khā hi/ zhes 'bul gtor gzhong sbubs pa'i 'og /tshe bdud mnan gzir bro yis sbyang*/ hrīḥ 'chi med bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// gnod byed tshe bdud pho mo'i tshogs// dbang chen khros pa'i rta bro ni// rab 'bar 'jig rten g.yo zhing ldeg /mnan no ma ldang sa ma ya// oṃ āḥhūm̐ suṃ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ nongs bshags mdun bskyed bsdu ba ni/ hrīḥ gu ru pad+ma yab yum dang*// tshe lha rigs lnga'i tshogs bcas dgongs| |bdag gi mi shes dbang gis ni// nyams par gyur gang bzod par bzhes// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ hrīḥ gtor ma lha yi gnas lnga ni// rigs lnga tshe lha yab yum rnams| |rang rang mdog can 'od du zhu// tshur 'phros bdag gi gnas lnga'i lhar// so sor thim pas 'chi med grub// gtor ma'i gu ru yab yum yang*// 'od zhu bdag la thim pa'i mod// rang lus phyi nang lha rnams kyang*// 'od zhu lnga ldan thig le che// stong gsal ti la ka nyag gcig

/rang mdangs ma bcos a la la// a kā ro sogs/ thun mtshams rang sems snang pa'i cha// snang cha yab la stong cha yum// na bza' dkar mo'i nga rgyal ldan// shis brjod bsngo ba smon lam ni/ hrīḥ 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe dbang stsol// mi shigs tshe yi bkra shis stsol// gnas lngar rigs kyi tshe dpag med// rigs lnga tshe yi bkra shis stsol// rtsa gsum zhi khro rgyal ba'i tshogs// byin rlabs tshe dpal bkra shis stsol// dam can gter bdag bka' srung tshogs// bar gcod kun sel bkra shis stsol// hrīḥ 'chi med bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// dus gsum rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs// bsdus te khams gsum 'gro ba kun// 'chi med rig 'dzin thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa'i las byang phyi dbang gi// mtshams sbyor bcas 'di kho bos bgyis// 'di yi gter gzhung nyid du yang*// 'di la dgos pa'i tshe yi las gzhung yang*// rgyas par byed na 'grel pa'i sgron me sbor// zhes gsung phyir na rgyas par 'dod rnams kyi// ched du 'di bris bsdus la dga' na yang*// gter byon nyid kyis dgos pa mchog tu 'grub// 'di rtsom byed po 'bri gung skyu ra'i rigs// shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pa zhes// gyi nar gyur pa 'khrul blo dang bral bar// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i dgongs pa 'khrul med bkod// 'di la 'ga' 'gas las gzhung dbang gi khrid// sna tshogs bsdus pa'i rtsom la 'thad mi 'thad// gter bdag srung ma'i tshogs rnams gnya' bo mdzod// de skad sa byi dbyar tha'i tshes bcu la// pho brang rtse bar bris dges 'gro ba rnams// 'chi med rig 'dzin rdo rje'i sa thob shog /maṅga laṃ// //tshe dbang 'chi bdag zil gnon 'di la bshes gnyen phal gyis ngag 'don byed par ni 'dod/ byed lugs ni ma shes par tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i dbang gi dag par bde mchog sogs sna tshogs spu tshogs 'gebs pa zhig snang mod/

de ni ches cher mi rigs la ngag 'don rgyas par 'dod na tshul 'di ni gter gzhung 'di ga'i 'don chog la brten nas tshe sgrub pa'i skabs kyis kha bskangs bas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i rgyas bshad du thag chod pas rang gis rang la yid ches so ang*// //
